copy.curiosityHook: Sent into a terrified province, two royal investigators must discover whether hundreds have fallen to an ordinary predator or something far more sinister.
copy.description: In 18th-century France, Chevalier de Fronsac and his companion Mani are dispatched by the King to the Gévaudan province, tasked with hunting down a mysterious beast responsible for hundreds of violent deaths.
copy.vibeSummary: Suspenseful and exciting historical horror; demands engaged attention over a deliberate, medium-paced mystery.
copy.whyWatch: Director Christophe Gans weaves historical drama, horror, and energetic action into an expansive, stylish mystery that treats its legendary monster hunt with grand cinematic ambition.

allowedMaterial: Chevalier de Fronsac and Mani sent by the King
Investigation into hundreds of killings by a mysterious beast
Director Christophe Gans and genre hybridity (action, adventure, horror, history)
excludedMaterial: True nature, origin, or identity of the beast
Late-game deaths, survival outcomes, or climax events
